mandatory_reason: Domestic Pressure Cooker is covered under the Domestic Pressure Cooker (Quality Control) Order, 2020. The QCO requires products covered by the order to bear the Standard Mark under a BIS licence as per Scheme-I. BIS currently lists Domestic Pressure Cooker against IS 2347 under Scheme-I. The latest applicable version of the Indian Standard is to be followed as notified by BIS.
application_route: Apply online to BIS for a product certification licence under Scheme-I through the BIS Manakonline portal. The manufacturer must demonstrate conformity to IS 2347, with assessment of manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality-control/testing capabilities and product conformity through the applicable BIS assessment and testing process.

mandatory_reason: Stationary storage type electric water heaters are covered under the applicable Quality Control Order and are required to conform to IS 2082:2018 and bear the Standard Mark under a BIS licence.
application_route: Apply for BIS product certification under Scheme-I through the BIS online certification portal, undergo factory assessment and product testing, and obtain a BIS licence before applying the Standard Mark.

mandatory_reason: Jewellers selling hallmarked gold and silver jewellery/artefacts are required to obtain BIS registration in areas covered by mandatory hallmarking requirements. Hallmarking is carried out through BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres.
application_route: Jeweller obtains BIS registration through the National Single Window System (NSWS) or BIS Manakonline portal, then submits a hallmarking request through the Hallmarking portal to a BIS-recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre. The centre receives and assays the jewellery and applies the hallmark to articles that conform to the required purity/fineness.
